title.en: An Act Creating the Barrios of Santo Domingo in the Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrios of Santo Domingo in the Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2123_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Suha, Bakis, Tolong Bata and Talon are separated from the barrio of Conde Itaas, Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, and are constituted into an independent and distinct barrio of Santo Domingo.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 5, 1959.
